description: Add a web-based voting UI served by Flask. Create a templates/index.html file with a responsive single-page application that allows users to vote for restaurants and view current vote counts. Modify app.py to serve this template from the / route.
steps: Create directory templates/ in the project root (/projects/sandbox/votingapp/templates/)

Create templates/index.html with a complete single-page voting UI that includes: (a) A header/title section with the app name, (b) Four voting buttons - one for each restaurant (Outback, Buca di Beppo, IHOP, Chipotle), (c) A results section showing current vote counts, (d) Embedded CSS for a clean, modern responsive design, (e) Embedded JavaScript that: calls POST to /api/<restaurant> when a vote button is clicked, calls GET /api/getvotes on page load and after each vote to refresh results, displays vote counts visually (e.g., bar chart or progress bars), handles errors gracefully

Modify app.py: add 'render_template' to the Flask import statement (line 3: from flask import Flask, render_template), then update the home() function to return render_template('index.html') instead of the current inline HTML string
Verify that app.py is syntactically valid by running: cd /projects/sandbox/votingapp && python3 -c "import ast; ast.parse(open('app.py').read()); print('Syntax OK')"
Verify the template exists and is valid HTML by checking the file was created at templates/index.html
acceptance_criteria: templates/index.html exists and contains a complete HTML document with embedded CSS and JavaScript
The HTML includes vote buttons for all four restaurants (outback, bucadibeppo, ihop, chipotle)
The JavaScript fetches /api/getvotes to display current results
The JavaScript calls /api/<restaurant> to cast votes when buttons are clicked
app.py passes syntax validation (python3 -c "import ast; ast.parse(open('app.py').read())")
verification: cd /projects/sandbox/votingapp && python3 -c "import ast; ast.parse(open('app.py').read()); print('Syntax OK')"
cd /projects/sandbox/votingapp && python3 -c "from flask import Flask, render_template; print('Imports OK')"
cd /projects/sandbox/votingapp && grep -q 'render_template' app.py && echo 'render_template found in app.py'
findings: All verification checks pass. Flask dependencies installed successfully with pip. Syntax validation, import validation, template existence, and render_template usage in app.py all confirmed. Vote endpoints use GET method (default Flask route), so the UI uses fetch() with GET requests to cast votes.
